item.title: AI News, Thursday November 12
item.description:
Thursday November 12: Adobe MAX Sneaks (Live Set, Scene Sweep, On Cue, Screen Test, Sound Bender), the Isfolket AI row in Norway, Rob Minkoff's AI film Storm Dogs, Nvidia's board weighs Jensen Huang's future, Runway's open-weight Praxis-1, film schools teaching AI, Gemini on CarPlay, model retirements and quick hits.

  1. Adobe MAX 2026 Sneaks: Previewing the future of creativity – Live Set, Scene Sweep, On Cue, Screen Test and Sound Bender research previews; see also [Variety on Project Live Set](https://variety.com/2026/digital/news/adobe-project-live-set-real-time-ai-video-editing-feature-1236943403/)
  2. KI-bråk rundt "Sagaen om Isfolket" – Rubicon and Reimagine plan generative AI for TV 2's Isfolket; NOK 4.2M NFI support sparks criticism
  3. The Lion King co-director is making an AI talking-dog film – Rob Minkoff directs Storm Dogs for Particle 6, per The Hollywood Reporter
  4. Nvidia board meets to decide CEO Huang's future – Stock down 8% after hours; results due Nov 17
  5. Runway Praxis-1 is now available – 27B open-weight world action model under Apache 2.0
  6. Hollywood warned young screenwriters about AI. Now it may be their ticket in – LA Times on film schools, AI pitch decks and Netflix's ~300 gen-AI programs
  7. Gemini is now available on Apple CarPlay – Gemini Live rolling out globally; Daily Brief not in the EEA
  8. Magnific API changelog – Kling 1.6/2.0/2.1 removed, ElevenLabs Voiceover v3 and v4 added; plus [Vyond on Veo 3.1 Fast retirement](https://product.vyond.com/lite-model-update-for-video-clip-generation/)
  9. Quick hits from The Neuron – United blocks agent bookings, Qwen4-Max-Preview, Gemini Decisions API, AWS Emulator, Ramp AI Index

item.title: AI News, Wednesday November 11
item.description:
Wednesday November 11: Adobe MAX puts generative video, Generative Remove and agents into Premiere, Firefly adds Seedance 2.5 and Nano Banana 2.1, Avid's Ready to Play brings Veo to Media Composer, Beeble SwitchX 3.0, ElevenLabs Scribe v3, Apple's Claris Harbor, pi-H3, Gemini 4 Carbon, Anthropic's IPO roadshow and quick hits.

  1. Adobe MAX: new Premiere tools, AI Assistant and Creative Cloud MCP preview – Generative Media in the timeline, Generative Remove (beta), Color Mode, Crosstalk separation; see also [Digital Production](https://digitalproduction.com/2026/11/10/adobe-max-2026-ai-video-audio-premiere-creative-agent/) on the early-2027 MCP timing
  2. Adobe Firefly expands as the AI creative studio – Creative Agent, Firefly Video timeline, Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, Nano Banana 2.1
  3. Avid launches Ready to Play for Media Composer – Create, Modify and Analyze Video with Gemini and Veo
  4. Beeble introduces SwitchX 3.0 – Source-locked relighting and background swaps, four references, 4K 10-bit
  5. ElevenLabs launches Scribe v3 and v3 Live – 27% fewer word errors, realtime diarization, Danish realtime up 54%
  6. Apple's Claris tests Harbor for local AI on Macs – Pool unified memory across Thunderbolt 5 Macs; early access only
  7. pi-H3: video generation in 2–4 steps – 5-second 768p clip with audio in 3.8 s on one B200; open source
  8. Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent swarm – $2/$10 intro pricing, /swarm preview in Antigravity
  9. Anthropic's IPO roadshow and Claude's office tools – ANT at $70–78 proposed, Claude Sheets and Whiteboards, free usage reset before Dec 10
  10. Quick hits from The Neuron – OpenAI's ~$10B quarter, ChatGPT voice changes on Dec 11, MiniMax H3-Image open weights

item.title: AI News, Tuesday November 10
item.description:
Tuesday November 10: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, Disney's custom Firefly models with Adobe, Apple's paid AI usage packs heading to Final Cut Pro, Weta FX on Hollywood's AI flip, Norway's Isfolket AI debate, Seedream 5.5 with transparent output, Paramount's Ellison on AI as the new CGI, Video-Coder's 3D blockouts, and quick hits.

  1. Anthropic introduces Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 – Up to 30% faster, $8/$40 per million tokens, extra Fable usage this week
  2. Adobe and Disney announce a multi-year AI alliance – Custom Firefly Foundry models trained on Disney properties
  3. Apple launches $50 intelligence usage packs – Logic Pro first, Final Cut Pro and Pixelmator Pro expected next
  4. Weta FX: "If you don't have an AI strategy, don't bother" – Studios flipped from banning gen AI to requiring it; Kling and Seedance where allowed
  5. Norwegian Film Workers want answers on AI in Isfolket – Rubicon's "VFX without green screen" sparks union concern (NTB, in Norwegian)
  6. ByteDance introduces Seedream 5.5 – Native RGBA output and stable editing across 100 rounds
  7. David Ellison: AI could be the biggest creative unlock in modern history – Paramount Skydance CEO compares AI to CGI, says it won't replace artists
  8. Video-Coder scripts 3D scenes before video generation – Blender blockouts guide the video model; plus [NVIDIA FastGen](https://thenextgentechinsider.com/pulse/nvidia-fastgen-accelerates-video-diffusion-inference-speed)
  9. Quick hits from The Neuron – OpenAI Control Room, Anthropic's retracted IPO details, Fireworks AI breach

item.title: AI News, Monday November 9
item.description:
Monday November 9: Higgsfield Miracle turns finished video into editable layers, Bruno Dumont's all-AI feature The End, DaVinci Resolve 21.2, Topaz Wonder 4, Korean producers warn about AI token costs, Nolan on training data, cheaper video models, Anthropic's agent memory research, and the post-midterm politics of AI power.

  1. Higgsfield Miracle: video into editable layers (private beta) – Layered, depth-aware edits without re-rendering; coming to Higgsfield MCP
  2. Bruno Dumont says he made his next film entirely with AI – The End, a sci-fi thriller made with no actors or crew; festivals and release planned for 2027
  3. DaVinci Resolve 21.2 released – Touch MacBook Pro support, multicam source timelines, stronger AI assistant via MCP
  4. Topaz for Web November release: Wonder 4 and Image HDR – One-pass upscale and repair, plus SDR-to-HDR with Apple-compatible gain maps
  5. AI could make films costlier than the 35mm era, Korean pioneers warn – Token bills, revision rounds and the AI feature Raphael, opening November 25
  6. Christopher Nolan previews the DGA's next phase of AI protections – The Odyssey's credits carry a no-AI-training notice
  7. Kling, LTX and MiniMax video models come to Microsoft Foundry via fal – Also [Wizstar's Wizshot 1.0](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/wizstar-launches-wizshot-1-0--its-first-in-house-video-generation-model-making-high-quality-ai-video-creation-more-cost-efficient-302932003.html) and [Higgsfield Micro Drama Ads](https://neurocartel.com/en/blog/ai-video-news-november-7-2026)
  8. Anthropic's four layers of agent memory – Keep the always-loaded layer small; one notes page per agent
  9. AI after the US midterms – Data center moratorium calls and Nvidia's 9% drop; plus [Anthropic's reported $3.4B power deal and Apple's AI push](https://www.theneuron.ai/digest/everything-that-happened-in-ai-today-monday-november-9-2026/)

item.title: AI News, Friday November 6
item.description:
Friday November 6: Final Cut Pro gets MotionVFX and AI image generation, Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash makes 15-second video cheaper, Higgsfield Elements for consistent shots, Fuji TV's all-AI drama plan, Korea's fully generated features, GPT-6 Cyber, METR on accelerating AI research, Runway and ElevenLabs in coding agents, and always-on agents.

  1. Apple Creator Studio update: Final Cut Pro gets MotionVFX, Pixelmator Pro round-trip and AI image generation – Free for existing subscribers; details in [Apple's release](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/10/apple-creator-studio-adds-powerful-new-ai-features-and-even-more-creative-tools/) and [RedShark News](https://www.redsharknews.com/apple-creator-studio-motionvfx-final-cut-pro-update)
  2. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 15-second video and 30% lower pricing – $0.07 per second at 720p; also in [Google Vids](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/workspace/omni-1-2-flash-google-vids/)
  3. Higgsfield adds Elements to Cinema Studio 4.0 – Reusable characters, locations and props with up to 50 references; see also the [Higgsfield changelog](https://www.higgsfield.company/creator-hub/changelog)
  4. Fuji TV to use generative AI in all live-action dramas from October 2027 – Nikkei Asia; article is paywalled
  5. AI movies make the leap to the big screen in Korea – Raphael opens Nov. 25 after 14 months of editing
  6. OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber – 948 Linux privilege escalation exploits and 81 new Firefox vulnerabilities, rated Critical for cybersecurity
  7. The Neuron: Anthropic's AI development is accelerating, per METR – Roughly twice the previous pace, with much of the evidence redacted
  8. Runway Dev plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor – Plus [ElevenLabs SFX v3 and Eleven Realtime](https://releasebot.io/updates/eleven-labs)
  9. Quick hits: Perplexity Teammates, Cursor web-app deploys, Claude Personal Finance – Always-on agents arrive across the board

item.title: AI News, Thursday November 5
item.description:
Thursday November 5: Kling 4.0 Flash opens with Premiere and After Effects plugins, a 17-point race atop the video arena, ChatGPT Images 2.6 GIFs, China's AI remix crackdown, Danish producers seeking Spanish romcoms, OpenAI's Hollywood push, cheaper Claude Code agents, Apple's AI budget cuts, Anthropic's AP deal and the labs round-up.

  1. Kling 4.0 Flash fully open, with Photoshop, Premiere and After Effects plugins – Also via API, MCP, CLI and AI plugins
  2. Wan 3.0 takes first place in the text-to-video arena – 17 Elo from first to sixth; Selendis announces Archon, edits from raw footage (waitlist, unverified)
  3. ChatGPT Images 2.6 adds animated GIFs – Frame editing, up to 50% faster; [Tesseract as editable finishing layer](https://aicrier.com/post/o4aqixj744nmj6uvo3r1); [Enkio music videos via MCP](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/954652166/enkio-mcp-brings-ai-music-video-creation-to-chatgpt-and-codex)
  4. China removes 11,000 AI remix videos; NBCU co-leads $80M for EloElo – Plus Jingrui AI, a 50+ model production canvas for 100 simultaneous editors
  5. Danish producers seek romcoms to co-produce with Spain – Danish broadcasters cover only 40-50% of budgets; Netflix AI Discover; unscripted as scripted training ground
  6. OpenAI's Hollywood charm offensive: Charles Porch – First VP of Global Creative Partnerships, per a New York Magazine profile
  7. Claude Code background agent updates ~99% cheaper – Haiku 5.5 writes status notes; Cat Wu joins OpenAI; OpenAI to buy Pierre; Meta buys Conductor
  8. Apple cuts employees' daily AI budgets – $300 to $200 for some engineers; push toward cheaper and on-device models
  9. Anthropic's first paid publisher deal, with AP – Judge dismisses claim against Dario Amodei in music publishers' suit, with leave to amend
  10. OpenAI agents find 948 Linux kernel exploits – ~$1.21M in credits; Kimi K3.1 Pro, Tencent Hy4, Claude helps solve a vault particle structure

item.title: AI News, Wednesday November 4
item.description:
Wednesday November 4: Disney tests AI lyric videos with OpenArt, Promise's gray box hybrid demo at Disney, Weta FX's AI hub in Taiwan, Banijay hiring an AI Creative Technologist, Glue Production on DR P1, Synthesia in ChatGPT, ElevenLabs SFX v3 in the API, Pika H3 Flex near real time, Siri AI opens to developers, and the labs round-up.

  1. Disney tests AI lyric videos with OpenArt – Starting with "Go the Distance"; concepts "in hours rather than weeks"; the whole Accelerator cohort is AI companies
  2. Promise shows artist-led hybrid production at Disney Demo Day – One actor performance in a gray box turned into different cinematic worlds
  3. Weta FX and TAICCA plan an AI screen production hub in Taiwan – Investment, R&D and talent training; formal launch Nov 6 at TCCF in Taipei
  4. Banijay Group is hiring an AI Creative Technologist – London, hybrid; map AI experiments across labels, prototype tools and scale pilots group-wide
  5. DR P1 K-Live: "Ja, AI kan lave gode film" – Esther Sofie Hede of AI production company Glue Production; segment starts at 01:59
  6. Synthesia launches in ChatGPT – Build and revise avatar videos from docs, decks and chats; "make it in Studio" for exact scripts
  7. ElevenLabs SFX v3 now in the API – `eleven_text_to_sound_v3`, ordered events and exact durations; looping only on v2
  8. Pika H3 Flex runs 7x faster in FastVideo – 5-second 480p clip in 5.8 s on one GB200 in 4-bit; open 2K regeneration
  9. Apple opens Siri AI to developers, warns about agents – App Intents in the iOS 27.3 betas; annual filing flags agents exceeding permissions
  10. Anthropic's S-1 warning, FlashProve, OpenAI's Pando and Cathedral deal – ~$17B Q3 revenue and an RSP threshold warning; Pando cuts push latency ~80% ([The Neuron](https://www.theneuron.ai/digest/everything-that-happened-in-ai-today-wednesday-november-4-2026/))

item.description:

item.title: AI News, Monday November 2
item.description:
Monday November 2: DR's new AI Lab and VIA's AI Frontier Lab opening in Aarhus today, Runway Character Swap, Kling 4.0 spreading to five more platforms, VEED's lip-synced Dubbing API, Tencent's open-source WeVisCut editing agent, TBC's half-cent-a-second mischief 1, Claude's Max/Ultra plan changes, a shared AI-training opt-out for robots.txt, Computer Use GA in Gemini plus OpenAI Agents API updates, and OpenAI's smaller fundraise.

  1. DR opretter AI-laboratorium og sætter egen mand i spidsen – Lasse Funder Andersen leads DR's new AI Lab from Nov 1; plus [VIA's AI Frontier Lab opens today 13:00 in Aarhus](https://filmbyaarhus.dk/aarhus-series-film-festival/program/branche/aabning-af-ai-frontier-lab) with Sally Trier and Bacon Lab's Mads Damsbo on the José González video and Bacon's AI code of conduct
  2. Runway App Studio adds Character Swap – replace characters or location while keeping the original motion, then transfer or swap audio; paid plans
  3. Kling 4.0 lands on 5+ platforms in one week – 30-second clips, 15 references, 10 keyframes; Genspark 50% off until Nov 4; also Runway Ads and Krea Ad Studio
  4. Introducing VEED's Dubbing API – translate, clone each voice, lip-sync; Standard $0.11/s (100 languages), Pro $0.18/s (multi-speaker, accents, background audio); up to 10 min; fal in early November
  5. Tencent open-sources 9B video agent WeVisCut – narration script to multi-minute edit with 12 tools; 90.5 vs Opus 5's 89.9 on the authors' own benchmark; Apache 2.0 with an editable timeline
  6. TBC launches mischief 1 – image-to-video at $0.005 per second on fal and OpenRouter; 5x faster than its base model (company claim)
  7. Claude Max 20x becomes Ultra, no 5-hour limit – Max stays $100, Ultra $200, weekly limits unchanged; plus [Claude Code 2.1.316's subagent effort setting](https://jls42.org/en/news/ia-actualites-31-oct-2026)
  8. Google joins OpenAI and Anthropic in new scraping controls – one robots.txt AI-training user agent honoured by Google, Anthropic, OpenAI and Microsoft; rollout through early 2027
  9. Computer Use GA in the Gemini API; OpenAI Agents API adds Auto Review – screen-driving agents with prompt-injection checks; command review, background compaction, time awareness
  10. FT: OpenAI cuts funding target by $10B – to about $20B at a $1.25T valuation target (media report); plus Google's space TPU sends back a haiku

item.title: AI News, Friday October 30
item.description:
Friday October 30: first hands-on verdicts on Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro, Pika's open-weights H3 Flex with five audio stems, ElevenLabs SFX v3, Claude Code mods, Fremantle's AI micro-drama recut of Neighbours, hybrid live-action/AI feature Beta Builder starting its shoot, Korea's 90-minute AI feature Steelay, SAG-AFTRA's AI dubbing consent deal, and OpenAI's rewritten Model Spec.

  1. Hands-on with Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro – taps fall back to clicks, magnified controls, no Pencil, $400 premium; third-party touch apps incl. DaVinci Resolve arrive "later this year" while Final Cut Pro gets Apple's own touch controls ([Mac Observer](https://www.macobserver.com/news/macbook-pro-touch-apps-list/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/apple/2026/10/touchscreen-macbook-pro-hands-on-oled-looks-great-on-a-mac/))
  2. Pika launches Pika H3 Flex – open weights, post-trained on MiniMax H3, six steps, 768p draft to 4K finish, 12 references, up to 5 audio stems (dialogue, score, SFX, Foley, ambience); Pika app from Nov 2
  3. Introducing SFX v3 in ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI – better multi-sound prompts, music and vocals, fewer artifacts; available now
  4. Claude Code mods – TypeScript functions that react to prompts, tool calls, permissions and UI events; not sandboxed, install only from trusted sources
  5. 'Like cutting up a Picasso': AI microdrama edit of Neighbours worries actors and crew – Fremantle and RoseBerry Media use AI to scan 9,300+ episodes for vertical micro-dramas starting with Margot Robbie; original footage only, human editor approves; cast and crew raise consent concerns
  6. Beta Builder, debut hybrid AI feature from Abundantia AiOn and InVideo – live-action shoot plus AI-driven production began Oct 29 in Mumbai; first of five films backed by ₹100 crore (~$10.5M)
  7. 'Steelay' opens new era for AI feature films – 90-minute Korean AI feature, under ~$750K in six months; shots picked from ~13,000 discarded options, human dubbing, mix and DI
  8. SAG-AFTRA ratifies TV animation contracts: AI dub consent – ~95% yes; specific consent needed for foreign-language replica dubs; plus unions' [amicus brief against blanket fair use](https://deadline.com/2026/10/sag-aftra-wga-afm-openai-copyright-court-battle-brief-1237209138/) in the OpenAI case
  9. An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI – five core values, new guidance on context, agency and side effects; most style guidance retired; the model is now called "GPT"

item.title: AI News, Thursday October 29
item.description:
Thursday October 29: Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro with Final Cut Pro touch, Higgsfield Cinema Studio 4.0, ElevenLabs' Cue aligner, ByteDance's AI short-drama studio, Google's Gemini 4 Carbon, Anthropic's red-team exploit research, SenseTime's open Code2Video, Banijay UK's restructure, and Idris Elba's Google-backed AI filmmaking program.

  1. Apple unveils MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch – tandem OLED, 2000 nits SDR/HDR, genlock, Final Cut Pro touch for marking ranges and pinch-zoom; from $2,899, ships Nov 6 ([ProVideo Coalition take](https://www.provideocoalition.com/apple-introduces-new-macbook-pro-with-proled-xdr-display-and-a-touchscreen/))
  2. Higgsfield Cinema Studio 4.0 – Director's Panel, 30-second multi-shot scenes, 50 references, decade and film-stock looks, Extend and Edit Video
  3. ElevenLabs: Forced alignment with Cue – character-level timing behind Scribe, subtitles and dubbing; an hour of audio in under a second; Forced Alignment API
  4. ByteDance launches AI studio for short-drama production – Jimeng's script-to-post workflow with shot replacement and style remakes for new markets
  5. Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon – Google's strongest cybersecurity and long-horizon model; limited Fairwind rollout; $2/$10 per million tokens introductory
  6. Anthropic: Discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities with Claude – unreleased model chained Chrome and Safari exploits; patch your Macs ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/anthropics-unreleased-ai-model-chains.html))
  7. SenseTime open-sources Code2Video – 27B Apache 2.0 model that writes code for each frame; for motion graphics and titles, not photoreal
  8. Banijay UK creates Banijay Scotland and restructures OMG and North One – Glasgow hub backed by Banijay Post Production; OMG refocused on scripted
  9. Idris Elba backs African AI filmmaking – Akuna Group's one-year course with $1M from Google; creators own their films

item.title: AI News, Wednesday October 28
item.description:
Wednesday October 28: Apple Creator Studio's big Final Cut Pro update, M6 MacBook Pro and iMac ahead of tonight's Pro and Tell, Google DeepMind's Genie 4, Genspark Media Studio, CapCut's EditPilot and ChatGPT plugin, Henge and Higgsfield's open Inside AI project, reviews of Musk's AI Odyssey, the Academy on human-driven work, and a first-day verdict on Denmark's AI outlet Y.

  1. Apple Creator Studio adds powerful new AI features and even more creative tools – free November update: MotionVFX built into Final Cut Pro, Content Hub stock video, Pixelmator round-trip, disconnect clips from the primary storyline, more keyframe easing, 23 new transcription languages; MCP in Keynote, Pages and Numbers
  2. Everything Apple announced this week so far – M6 14" MacBook Pro from $1,999 and M6 iMac from $1,499, pre-orders today, available Nov 6; OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro expected at Pro and Tell, 18:00 CET ([MacRumors preview](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/10/19/apple-october-28-product-launch/))
  3. Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation – real-time steerable worlds with native music, ambience and dialogue; trusted testers now, AI Ultra and Gemini API partners next
  4. Genspark Media Studio – agent "director" plans script, storyboard and budget, then orchestrates Seedance 2.5, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs and more; multi-track timeline and 3D blockout stage
  5. CapCut World Los Angeles announcements – EditPilot natural-language editing, Generative and Interactive Edit, and a ChatGPT plugin for conversational first cuts in the coming months
  6. Henge open studio, plus Higgsfield open-sources Inside AI – MIT ComfyUI/MiniMax H3 app for character swap, head swap and motion transfer with MCP; needs 32 GB VRAM locally; #OpenSourceHiggsfield closes Oct 30
  7. Reviewers slate Musk's AI-made Odyssey film – one star from Peter Bradshaw; Wonder Studios made the 7-minute episode in under two weeks with a team of three, 7.3M views
  8. Oscars will 'always' reward human excellence in AI era – Academy president on human-driven workflow, copyright and disclosure; plus [Ava DuVernay defends AI-animated photos in 14th](https://filmstories.co.uk/news/ava-duvernay-defends-ai-use-for-animating-moments-in-her-latest-film/)
  9. Nyt AI-medie uden journalister skuffer forsker – DMJX's Peder Hammerskov: 22 of 43 day-one articles from Ritzau, Reuters or press releases; audio versions the most innovative part but lack context

item.title: AI News, Tuesday October 27
item.description:
Tuesday October 27: Projekt Y goes live at 13:00, Runway's no-code App Studio, ByteDance Jimeng's short-drama studio, China's first AI feature Sanxingdui flopping at the box office, Riverside's video-editing agents, OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra, Anthropic's IPO filing, Apple's iPad mini and Pro and Tell week, and new AI studios Inevitable and Lux Meridian.

  1. I morgen går nyt AI-medie i luften: 'Vi går faktisk mod strømmen' – Michael Dyrby's AI-assisted outlet Y launches today at 13:00 on y.dk; text plus audio versions, 40-50 articles/day goal, RUC researcher Aske Kammer sceptical ([B.T.](https://www.bt.dk/samfund/dansk-medie-med-nyheder-skrevet-af-kunstig-intelligens-lanceres-tirsdag))
  2. Introducing Runway App Studio – describe a tool in plain language and get a custom app using your Brand Kits and Workflows; built-ins include Character Swap, 3D Camera Control and Precise Edit; included in all paid plans
  3. ByteDance launches AI studio for short-drama production – Jimeng combines script (DreamScript), images (Anycook), storyboards (DreamShot), production and post; shot replacement and restyling dramas for other markets
  4. China's first AI feature flops at the Chinese box office – Bona's Sanxingdui: Future Past made ~RMB1.21M ($181K) through Monday vs RMB10M+ cost; Vidu-powered, grading and 5.1 mix still conventional ([Magica](https://magica.com/news/bona-sanxingdui-future-past-ai-film-opening-box-office))
  5. The first team of AI agents built for video – Riverside Agents: Producer, Editor, Clipper and Marketer on web and iOS; nothing publishes without your sign-off
  6. Introducing GPT-6.1 Terra – fast, cheaper computer-use model; benchmark tasks include time-coded shot logging of an animated film; $1/$5 per million input/output tokens
  7. Anthropic files S-1 for proposed IPO – Nasdaq ticker ANT, size and price not set; H1 2026 revenue $16.3B, founders keep 50.1% voting power ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/26/anthropic-officially-files-for-its-public-debut/))
  8. Apple gives iPad mini its biggest update ever – 8.5" OLED, A20 Pro, IP67, from $699, pre-orders Oct 28, available Nov 6; touchscreen MacBook Pro expected at "Pro and Tell" Oct 28, 18:00 CET ([Macworld live blog](https://www.macworld.com/article/3268887/pro-and-tell-event-live-blog-apples-last-launch-of-the-year-happens-now.html))
  9. AI studio Inevitable raises €15m funding – French studio aims for ≤100-min features in four months for $250K; plus Territory Group's [Lux Meridian](https://thegenerated.com/notes/the-team-behind-dune-s-screens-launches-an-ai-20261026) built on Adobe Firefly Foundry, unnamed Hollywood studio deal

  4. China's first AI feature flops at the Chinese box office – Bona's Sanxingdui: Future Past made ~RMB1.21M ($181K) through Monday vs RMB10M+ cost; Vidu-powered, grading and 5.1 mix still conventional ([Magica](https://magica.com/news/bona-sanxingdui-future-past-ai-film-opening-box-office))

  7. Anthropic files S-1 for proposed IPO – Nasdaq ticker ANT, size and price not set; H1 2026 revenue $16.3B, founders keep 50.1% voting power ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/26/anthropic-officially-files-for-its-public-debut/))

item.title: AI News, Monday October 26
item.description:
Monday October 26: Seedance 2.5 4K for film and TV, Seedance 2.5 and Seedream 5.0 Pro rolling out in Europe on Dreamina, Higgsfield's TCV/NVIDIA Series B extension plus Comfy's Open Source Higgsfield challenge, Tencent's steerable Hy-Nomas world model, Apple's OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro on Wednesday, Grok Imagine's first Odyssey episode, Kore-eda on AI script notes, Danish AI-driven news outlet Y, OpenAI's offline frontier training, and the Elvis estate suing Anthropic.

  1. ByteDance launches Seedance 2.5 4K video model for film production – 4K, 10-bit colour, 480p Draft mode; enterprise trials with ~20 studios/directors, satellite TV broadcast as early as November ([TokenPost](https://www.tokenpost.com/news/technology/39400))
  2. Dreamina Seedance 2.5 and Dola Seedream 5.0 Pro – Seedance 2.5 rolling out to subscribers in Europe in the coming week: 30s clips, up to 50 references, timestamp edits; Seedream 5.0 Pro with layer editing; C2PA credentials
  3. Higgsfield extends Series B with TCV and NVIDIA – amount undisclosed; company-reported 40M+ users, $1B+ run rate; plus [Comfy's Open Source Higgsfield challenge](https://comfy.org/open-source-higgsfield/), $10K top prize, closes Oct 30 9am PT (17:00 CET)
  4. Tencent opens Hy-Nomas, an interactive video-world model – steer with text and camera paths between segments; Apache 2.0 weights, 720p/24fps, single-RTX-4090 config; benchmark has no published scores
  5. Apple reportedly announcing OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro on Wednesday – per Gurman: 14"/16", Dynamic Island, lighter, M5 Pro/Max, up to $500 more; "Pro and tell" Oct 28, 10am PT (18:00 CET)
  6. Grok Imagine releases first AI-generated Odyssey episode – 7-minute episode with Wonder Studios and director Dev Walker, after Musk promised a full-length film by year-end
  7. Kore-eda ditched AI script notes on Sheep in the Box – "It only ever says correct things... what made this so boring"; no AI used on the film
  8. Projekt Y goes live next Tuesday – Danish news outlet using AI in every stage of production, launches Oct 27 under Michael Dyrby; CTO interview on agents, EU data centre and open-weight models ([Ingeniøren](https://pro.ing.dk/aitech/artikel/nu-lancerer-tidligere-topprofil-paa-tv-2-nyt-ai-medie-saadan-skal-det-undgaa-hallucinere))
  9. OpenAI will no longer train its models on the live internet – cached/simulated web instead after a Sept 20 escape via misconfiguration ([OpenAI post](https://openai.com/index/securing-our-frontier-model-training-environment))
  10. Anthropic sued over 274 Elvis Presley songs – Authentic Brands Group seeks $150K per song (~$41M); one of the first major estate-vs-AI-developer cases
